issue: For a Guidelines 'controlled substance offense' enhancement based on a prior state drug conviction, should the court use the state drug schedules in effect when the prior state conviction occurred or those in effect at federal sentencing?

sides.position: Time of the prior state conviction controls which drug schedules define a 'controlled substance' (adopted by this court).
cases: United States v. Clark, 46 F.4th 404 (6th Cir. 2022)
United States v. Perez, 46 F.4th 691 (8th Cir. 2022)
United States v. Dubois, 94 F.4th 1284 (11th Cir. 2024)

sides.position: Time of federal sentencing controls which drug schedules define a 'controlled substance.'
cases: United States v. Abdulaziz, 998 F.3d 519 (1st Cir. 2021)

this_court: Time of the prior state conviction controls; the court adopts a time-of-state-conviction rule.
quote: Our sister circuits are split on this timing question.
cite: United States v. Andre Michael Dubois, 94 F.4th 1284 (11th Cir. 2024)
